_note: Transposed from OpenAIResponsesAdapter.parseStreamEvent. A clean discriminated union, so nearly all of it is cases. The one thing that spans events is `phase`: announced once when an item is added, but belonging on every text delta of that item, which carry only item_id.

phaseByItem._note: item id -> phase, so codex-family narration can be told from the answer.

openShell._note: The shell_call waiting for its output item, so builtin_tool_end reports the commands AND what they printed. A container-run shell splits across two items.

response.shell_call_command.delta._note: The command text as the model composes it. `.added` carries an empty command and `.done` repeats the finished one, so neither is handled: both would duplicate text a consumer appends. xAI names its equivalent `response.shell_call_arguments.*` and sends one JSON string instead, which is not a fragment of anything displayable, so it has no case here -- its item already carries the finished commands.

response.shell_call_output_content.delta._note: stdout/stderr from a container-run shell. Only OpenAI, and only with `environment: container_auto`: xAI runs shell commands locally, so nothing streams back. `delta` is an object here, not a string.

response.output_item.done._note: Files first, and as a rule of its own: xAI overrides this transform, and on the buffered side calling the module function directly is how that override got silently dropped.
